segments.t: Outside the wine-tasting reception in Burgundy, Andréa Martel has a sudden revelation. Hicham Janowski, her former high-school classmate, has just sold his company for two hundred million euros. She convinces Gabriel that Hicham could be the savior ASK desperately needs, then sprints across the courtyard to catch him. Listen to the scene in French first.
Ce type, c'est la poule aux œufs d'or.
Il a vendu son site pour deux cents millions.
Tu m'écoutes, Gabriel?
Oui, mais pourquoi investirait-il chez nous?
Sa mère m'a dit qu'il divorce.
Il cherche un nouveau projet.
Je vais lui parler, il est prêt.
Lui parler comment?
Nous étions de très bons amis au lycée.
Regarde! Attends!
Hicham, attends!
Alors, Andréa... tu as couru pour me dire au revoir?
Tu vas où?
À l'aéroport de Dole.
Tu peux me déposer au tournage? C'est sur la route.
Léa Seydoux te remerciera en personne. Promis.
Let's explore Andréa's spontaneous pitch line by line.
Ce type, c'est la poule aux œufs d'or.
'This guy is the golden goose.' Andréa spots a massive financial opportunity. The French expression literally says the hen with golden eggs.
Il a vendu son site pour deux cents millions.
'He sold his website for two hundred million.' She shares the incredible news with Gabriel. The key word here means 'has', paired with 'one million' to make the point clear.
Tu m'écoutes, Gabriel?
'Are you listening to me, Gabriel?' She snaps her colleague's attention back to her plan. The short object word precedes the verb.
Oui, mais pourquoi investirait-il chez nous?
'Yes, but why would he invest in us?' Gabriel remains cautious and skeptical. Listen for the expression meaning 'yes', which leads naturally into 'would he invest'.
Sa mère m'a dit qu'il divorce.
'His mother told me that he is getting divorced.' Andréa reveals her insider intelligence. Andréa pairs the verb meaning 'told me' with the noun for 'mother'.
Il cherche un nouveau projet.
'He is looking for a new project.' She notes that he needs a fresh challenge. The key word here means 'is looking for', paired with 'project' to make the point clear.
Je vais lui parler, il est prêt.
'I am going to speak to him, he is ready.' Andréa decides to make her move immediately. The near future combines to go with an infinitive.
Lui parler comment?
'Speak to him how?' Gabriel wonders what leverage she could possibly have. Notice the short object word placed before the verb.
Nous étions de très bons amis au lycée.
'We were very good friends in high school.' She reminds Gabriel of their past bond. The key word here means 'were', paired with 'high school' to make the point clear.
Regarde! Attends!
'Look! Wait!' Seeing Hicham's car about to leave, she shouts urgently. Andréa opens with the word for 'look' and lands on 'wait' at the close.
Hicham, attends!
'Hicham, attends!' She calls after him as he starts his engine. Andréa gives a direct command form using the verb for 'wait'.
Alors, Andréa... tu as couru pour me dire au revoir?
'So, Andréa... you ran to say goodbye to me?' Hicham rolls down his window with a teasing smirk. The question uses the conversational past tense.
Tu vas où?
'Where are you going?' Andréa quickly checks his destination. The question places the question form word at the end.
À l'aéroport de Dole.
'To Dole airport.' Hicham explains that he is heading back to his private jet. Hicham opens with the word for 'the airport' and lands on 'the airport' at the close.
Tu peux me déposer au tournage? C'est sur la route.
'Can you drop me off at the shoot? It's on the way.' She maneuvers her way into his sports car. Andréa pairs the verb meaning 'can' with the noun for 'way'.
Léa Seydoux te remerciera en personne. Promis.

'Léa Seydoux will thank you in person. Promised.' She sweetens the ride with a star encounter. The future simple expresses a confident promise. Now let's listen to the entire dialogue once more from beginning to end.
Ce type, c'est la poule aux œufs d'or.
Il a vendu son site pour deux cents millions.
Tu m'écoutes, Gabriel?
Oui, mais pourquoi investirait-il chez nous?
Sa mère m'a dit qu'il divorce.
Il cherche un nouveau projet.
Je vais lui parler, il est prêt.
Lui parler comment?
Nous étions de très bons amis au lycée.
Regarde! Attends!
Hicham, attends!
Alors, Andréa... tu as couru pour me dire au revoir?
Tu vas où?
À l'aéroport de Dole.
Tu peux me déposer au tournage? C'est sur la route.
Léa Seydoux te remerciera en personne. Promis.
Andréa has managed to slip into Hicham's passenger seat, setting up the perfect moment to pitch ASK. Remember the classic idiom for a goldmine: la poule aux œufs d'or. See you next time!
Au revoir!
